name: Thymoma and thymic carcinoma
theme: the two-disease mediastinum · the same drug, two verdicts

meta.title: Thymoma & thymic carcinoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Thymic epithelial tumors (TETs): thymoma (WHO A-B3) and thymic carcinoma
meta.population: Adults with thymic epithelial tumors - THE TWO-DISEASE MEDIASTINUM: thymoma (indolent, organotypic, autoimmune-entangled - myasthenia gravis in ~30% [corrected from the briefing's 30-40: snippets run 'about 30%', range 15-50 across series], Good syndrome up to 5% verified, PRCA) and thymic CARCINOMA (aggressive, metastasizing, autoimmunity 'typically does not occur' - the NCCN 2.2025 two-disease snippet verified, PMID 40499586). Rarest-of-rare: thymoma 0.13 per 100,000 person-years (Engels verified; recent US series 2.0-2.2 per million), carcinoma 0.48 per million. THE STAGING CORRECTION (45th) ships up front: the 8th-edition TNM was invasion-based ('neighborhood') - but the NINTH EDITION IS LIVE (published 2025-01, 11,347 patients): SIZE now enters the T classification - the old 'neighborhood not size' line is only historically true, and this trainer's tag was corrected mid-run to match. THE SIGNATURE IS THE SAME DRUG, TWO VERDICTS: pembrolizumab is a THREAT in thymoma (Cho verified VERBATIM: grade >=3 immune-related events in 5 OF 7 thymoma patients - 71.4% with the n printed, correction 46th - including myocarditis and myasthenia gravis) and a TOOL in thymic carcinoma (Giaccone verified verbatim: ORR 22.5%, DCR 75%, careful monitoring urged) - enforced by property: no checkpoint inhibitor on any thymoma card; pembrolizumab carded with caveats on the carcinoma side only.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the two-disease mediastinum. THE BORDERS: mediastinal LYMPHOMA reroutes LIVE to the pmbcl trainer (the registry's TWENTIETH live reroute - primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma is literally the anterior-mediastinal-mass mimic); the germ-cell mimic blocks on AFP/bHCG (the cup trainer's same alarm); thymic NET (carcinoid) blocks to the NET family's borderland (the LEVEL trial's population, not this trainer's). meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO A/AB/B1/B2/B3 thymoma vs thymic carcinoma (the two-disease router); TNM staging per IASLC/ITMIG - 8th edition quartet verified (the 2014-dated-papers trap noted) and the 9TH EDITION LIVE (size enters T - correction 45th); Masaoka-Koga as the historical scaffold; profile router = resectable thymoma / advanced thymoma / thymic carcinoma
meta.response: Imaging response conventions; R0 resection as the dominant prognostic act (convention-grade); the pleural-recurrence pattern (92% of thymoma recurrences in one verified series) surveilled for years

Newly diagnosed.name: Thymectomy (R0 the act; PORT the question) - resectable thymoma
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention + registry-verified surgery receipts; PORT retrospective-grade (first RCT accruing)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: thymectomy morbidity; the MG peri-operative layer where present
Newly diagnosed.patient: For removable thymoma: an operation - complete removal is the single most important act - with a muscle-weakness blood test first and a case-by-case radiation discussion after.
drugs: Thymectomy (R0-intent; MIS or open) +/- postoperative RT by stage/margin

Newly diagnosed.name: CAP-based therapy (advanced thymoma - where IO is banned)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: advanced-thymoma convention (CAP verified; IO banned by property)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 2 verbatim receipts; the ban verified on trial data
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: anthracycline-platinum ledger - and NOT immune toxicity, by design
Newly diagnosed.patient: For advanced slow-type thymoma: classic three-drug chemotherapy - half of patients respond - sometimes converting the tumor to operable; immunotherapy is deliberately NOT offered here.

Newly diagnosed.name: Carboplatin-paclitaxel era + the 2025 rewrite (thymic carcinoma)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: carcinoma 1L convention + the 2025 phase-2 pair (grades printed)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 2 receipts (verified); Japan approval weak-source; no FDA approval
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: platinum-taxane ledger (+ the IO/antiangiogenic adds where chosen, with their own ledgers)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the aggressive kind: two-drug chemotherapy as the backbone - with 2025 bringing two promising add-on combinations (an immunotherapy and a blood-vessel blocker), both from smaller trials and honestly labeled as options, not standards.
drugs: Carboplatin-paclitaxel (+/- atezolizumab per MARBLE / ramucirumab per RELEVENT - option-grade, labeled)

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice at every step.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Re-resection + the thymoma shelf (recurrent thymoma - IO still banned)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: operative or regimen-dependent; never immune, by design
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When slow-type thymoma returns - usually on the lung lining, often years later: surgery again is frequently the best move, with chemotherapy and other drug options behind it.
drugs: Pleural re-resection where feasible; CAP rechallenge / octreotide (scan-gated) / everolimus (pneumonitis-vigilant)

Relapsed / recurrent.name: The carcinoma shelf (sunitinib / lenvatinib / pembrolizumab-with-monitoring / PECATI's pair)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: carcinoma 2L+ conventions (all receipts verified; all off-label - no FDA approval)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 2 receipts verified verbatim; approval absence verified
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: TKI ledgers (hypertension, fatigue) / immune events with monitoring - carcinoma's manageable version
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When the aggressive kind progresses: a real shelf - two targeted pills, immunotherapy with careful monitoring, or their combination - all supported by trials in exactly this disease.
drugs: Sunitinib or lenvatinib or pembrolizumab (with monitoring) or lenvatinib+pembrolizumab (PECATI-informed)

refs.label: THE TWO-DISEASE RECEIPT, verified: NCCN Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas v2.2025 (JNCCN - PMID 40499586, pubmed-url-match): thymoma's 'autoimmune paraneoplastic diseases (such as myasthenia gravis)... typically do not occur in patients with thymic carcinoma' (verbatim snippet) - the router's own receipt; biopsy-vs-resect conventions | PMID 40499586 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EPI (the registry's rarest): thymoma 0.13 per 100,000 person-years (Engels, 'Epidemiology of thymoma and associated malignancies' - PMID 20859116, pubmed-url-match); recent US series 2.0-2.2 per million (PMC10805269); thymic carcinoma 0.48 per million (NCCN summary snippet). The briefing's ~1.5/million sat inside the spread; Engels quoted verbatim | PMID 20859116 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

STAGING WITH THE LIVE CORRECTION (45th): the 8th-edition IASLC/ITMIG quartet ALL pubmed-url-matched (stage 25396314; T-component 25396315 - 'four categories, representing levels of invasion'; N/M 25396316 - N1 anterior/N2 deep, M1a pleural/pericardial, M1b distant; node map 25396317) - THE DATING TRAP: the papers are 2014 ('forthcoming 8th edition'); citing them as 2017 invites a date-check failure. THE 9TH EDITION IS LIVE (JTO 2023 proposal, published 2025-01; 11,347 patients; mirror-verified): SIZE ENTERS THE T CLASSIFICATION, T2/T3 revised, node map validated - 'neighborhood not size' is now a historical line (this trainer's tag was corrected mid-run); the exact size cut held at memory grade, not printed | PMID 25396314 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE SURGICAL SPINE: R0 as dominant prognostic act (convention-grade - universally asserted, no verbatim snippet this sweep, said as such); MIS = open on completeness, at meta-analysis grade (PMID 26762737, J Thorac Oncol 2016;11(1), abstract re-read firsthand 2026-09-10): 30 studies and 2038 patients comparing minimally invasive with open thymectomy; 'when patients with Masaoka stage I and II thymic malignancy only were analyzed, there was no difference in rate of R0 resection or overall recurrence rate', with less blood loss and shorter length of stay after minimally invasive surgery and no difference in operating time or in respiratory, cardiac or overall complications, concluding that minimally invasive thymectomy 'can achieve oncologic outcomes similar to those of open thymectomy'. CAVEAT the meta-analysis states plainly and this card carries: it is UNADJUSTED, and the groups were not alike - Masaoka stage I-II made up 94.89% of the minimally invasive group but only 78.62% of the open group. CORRECTION at this read: an 'international registry propensity-matched n=266/arm, R0 96% both arms' claim previously stood here marked VERIFIED with no PMID; it is not in PMID 26762737 and no source for it could be produced, so it has been removed rather than left carrying a verification it never had | PMID 26762737 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE PORT QUESTION at exact grade: Rimner ITMIG retrospective (PMID 27346413, pubmed-url-match: 'Postoperative Radiation Therapy Is Associated with Longer Overall Survival in Completely Resected Stage II and III Thymoma' - n=1,263; ASSOCIATION; 'remains controversial' in-source) + the 2022 stage-II analysis (35227565, matched: NO significant OS/DFS benefit) + R1/R2 and carcinoma conventions (memory-grade). THE FIRST PHASE 3 EVER RUN IN TETs is randomizing exactly this: RADIO-RYTHMIC (NCT04731610, France - PORT vs surveillance, resected IIb/III thymoma; NOT a US door) | PMID 27346413 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE CHEMO SPLIT: CAP (Loehrer, JCO 1994 - PMID 8201378, pubmed-url-match: cisplatin 50/doxorubicin 50/cyclophosphamide 500; ORR 50% [95% CI 31.3-68.7; 3 CR + 12 PR] - VERBATIM) - THE THREE-LOEHRER TRAP documented (1994 metastatic CAP / 1997 CAP+RT intergroup / 2004 octreotide); carbo-taxol (Lemma, JCO 2011 - 21502559, matched - THE GARBLED-SNIPPET CAUTION: the returned ORR text cannot be arithmetically right; the thymoma-42.9%/carcinoma-21.7% split held at memory grade, not printed as verified) + Hirai WJOG4207L (25403584, matched - the carcinoma-dedicated phase 2; ORR memory-grade). The anthracycline-for-thymoma / carbo-taxol-for-carcinoma split = convention consistent with all receipts | PMID 8201378 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: JCO x2 + Ann Oncol (matched; traps documented)

refs.label: THE TWO VERDICTS (the signature), both halves VERBATIM: THYMOMA - Cho (JCO - PMID 29906252, pubmed-url-match): 'Five (71.4%) of SEVEN patients with thymoma and four (15.4%) of 26 patients with thymic carcinoma reported grade >= 3 immune-related adverse events, including hepatitis, myocarditis, myasthenia gravis' - the n=7 ALWAYS printed (correction 46th). CARCINOMA - Giaccone (Lancet Oncol 2018 - 29395863, matched): ORR 22.5% (10.8-38.5; 1 CR + 8 PR of 40); DCR 75%; 'careful monitoring.' THE CONFLATION TRAP: adjacent papers, constantly swapped. THE SUPPORTING LAYER: avelumab thymoma series ~37% autoimmune events; anti-AChR antibodies + B-cell lymphopenia PREDICT myositis (the biomarker-of-danger); NIVOTHYM cohort 2 (nivo+ipi, B3/TC): NEGATIVE - prespecified 6-mo PFS bar not reached, added toxicity, 2 grade-4 myocarditis events in the program (correction 51st: a tested-and-closed question); European trials gate IO to B3/TC while the NCI keeps thymoma in under monitoring (the exclusion nuance) | PMID 29906252 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: JCO + Lancet Oncol + trial layer (matched verbatim; traps documented)

refs.label: THE TARGETED SHELF, carcinoma-sided and labeled: SUNITINIB (Lancet Oncol 2015, mirror-verified: thymic-CARCINOMA cohort 6/23 PR = 26%, 65% SD - the thymoma cohort did poorly; the blur refused; STYLE (JTO 2023) the modern confirmation); LENVATINIB REMORA (Lancet Oncol 2020, snippet-verified: ORR 38% [90% CI 25.6-52.0], 16/42 PR - THE LTFU TRAP: the 2024 long-term paper 38626709 is a different citation); EVEROLIMUS (Zucali, JCO 2018 - 29240542, matched - WITH the verified safety beat: 'a high rate of fatal pneumonitis was observed'); OCTREOTIDE+prednisone (Loehrer JCO 2004, title-verified: enrollment REQUIRED a positive octreotide scan - the scan-gated convention) | PMID 29240542 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Lancet Oncol x2 + JCO x2 (matched/mirror; sides labeled)

refs.label: THE 1L CARCINOMA PAIR + THE 2025 REWRITE (corrections 49th/50th): RELEVENT (Italian TYME, NCT03921671; Ann Oncol 2024, mirror-verified): ramucirumab+carbo-taxol - ORR 80%, DCR 100%, mPFS 18.1 (single-arm; 2 MIs among SAEs) - taught BESIDE S1701 (SWOG; JTO CRR 2024): the only US randomized TET trial - HALTED for slow accrual at n=21; ORR 88% vs 40% (p=0.04); PFS HR 0.51, p=0.13 NOT significant - phase-2 activity, never a phase-3 register. MARBLE (Japan; Lancet Oncol 2025, journal-verified): atezolizumab+carbo-taxol 1L carcinoma - ORR 56% by ICR, DCR 98%, mPFS 9.6 -> JAPAN approved atezo-chemo for unresectable thymic carcinoma 2025-12 (WEAK-SOURCE grade, flagged; the first ICI indication in the disease) - 'no FDA approval' HOLDS. PECATI (Spain/Italy/France; Lancet Oncol 2025 - PMID 40907517 surfaced): lenvatinib+pembrolizumab, pretreated B3/TC - 5-month PFS 88% (primary met), mPFS 14.9, 12-mo OS 85%; enrolled WITHOUT active autoimmune disease (the selection lesson) - THE ORR-CONFLATION TRAP: a circulating '38% (25.6-52.0)' is REMORA's exact CI; no PECATI ORR printed without direct verification. THE THREE-RAM-CITATIONS TRAP (protocol/results/S1701) documented
refs.src: Ann Oncol + JTO CRR + Lancet Oncol x2 (verified; traps documented)

refs.label: THE RECURRENCE CHAPTER, verified: pleural dominance ('most frequent recurrent type is pleural dissemination (92%)' - one series; pleura most common across series: PMIDs 11745803 + 19379989 + 9436541, all pubmed-url-matched); re-resection real - post-recurrence 5-yr OS 43-71% across series; surgery-treated recurrences outlive non-surgical management (SELECTION-CONFOUNDED - said); the late-recurrence clock (a decade-plus carcinoma counterexample exists - color, not a card) | PMID 11745803 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE AUTOIMMUNE LAYER: MG ~30% (snippets: 'about 30%', '15-29.6%'; range 15-50 across series - correction 47th from the briefing's 30-40); AChR screening before thymectomy = guideline-recommended (the 'mandatory' snippet never found - phrased as the receipts allow); GOOD SYNDROME up to 5% VERIFIED (PMID 23467629, pubmed-url-match); PRCA (systematic review PMC8710742) with the verified pearl: cyclosporine improves the PRCA but NOT the hypogammaglobulinemia (distinct mechanisms); the MG drug world (FcRn inhibitors; nipocalimab approved 2025) is neurology's - no tumor-crossover trial exists (verified absence) | PMID 23467629 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

SEER ANCHORS (correction 48th): thymic CARCINOMA 5-yr OS ~30% (SEER n=290; median 48 months - snippet-verified; series 25-34%) - the briefing's 30-50 band re-anchored to its verified floor; THYMOMA 5-yr relative ~79-80% (localized 94%; 10-yr 71.5%) - the classic stage-I-II 10-yr 80-90% claims held at memory grade

THE CENSUS (the thinnest yet): sacituzumab govitecan (NCT06248515 - parallel cohorts INCLUDING thymoma A; Georgetown-led; RECRUITING - one of pure thymoma's TWO doors); ivonescimab (NCT06980077 - RESOLVED: UCLA investigator-initiated ph2, Jonsson CCC-funded, single-agent, ORR primary, ~25 pts search-synthesis grade, ages 18+, previously treated thymic carcinoma; recruiting per UC listings; thymoma inclusion unconfirmed; UC-system-only sites); NCI layer (avelumab NCT03076554 thymoma+TC - [REGISTRY FIRSTHAND 2026-08-22: ACTIVE, NOT RECRUITING, est. primary completion 2027-03-30 - no longer an enrollable door; prior claim: accrual unverified]; bintrafusp NCT04417660 stale); PT-112 (NCT05104736 - interim bar MET in recurrent thymoma, 3/10 PRs - ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING = a watch, not a door); EX-US: iThyme (China, ivonescimab+chemo 1L), Chinese adjuvant RT randomized trials (unverified). DESERTS: no randomized systemic trial open anywhere; no US randomized door; no biomarker-gated TET trial; no TET PRRT (LEVEL NCT05918302 = thymic NETs, the border); no MG-crossover trial; no B7-H3/HER2 ADC door (IDeate excludes thymic)

RADIO-RYTHMIC (NCT04731610, France/RYTHMIC): PORT vs surveillance in completely resected Masaoka-Koga IIb/III THYMOMA - THE FIRST PHASE 3 EVER RUN IN THYMIC EPITHELIAL TUMORS (correction 49th: zero have ever completed; S1701 was randomized phase 2 and halted) - ongoing; NOT a US door; any interim action rewrites the PORT card

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
